stage.signin.intro: One normal Microsoft sign-in in an embedded window: you sign in yourself. AVDTune gets four tokens from it, one for Microsoft Graph, one for the SharePoint site, one for Azure Resource Manager and one for Azure Storage (the NTFS rows of the FSLogix check; optional, an older app registration without it signs in without that token and says so). Microsoft puts every consented permission of a resource into its token, so both Graph tokens carry all Graph permissions listed here; extra permissions are reported as a warning. The tokens live in memory only and are removed on closing, on sign out and by Finish.

Create one here (incremental, named by the pattern of this environment) or choose an existing one, then confirm it with your first and last name. When AVDTune already changed the master in this version, choose a snapshot from the start of the version or one made after the last change; snapshots that do not count are grey with the reason. Until then every page is read only.
